items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: George Hamilton Green and Wheeler Wadsworth, and they used to play one that I copied, that is, no music. By ear.

ctx.x: They didn't have a drummer, they just had a piano. I think it was maybe Frankie Bennett, somebody like that. Frankie Bennett and maybe Joe Green or one of the Greens. George Hamilton Green and Wheeler Wadsworth, and they used to play one that I copied, that is, no music. By ear. "Just Blue." It was a fantastic C-melody saxophone which the guy played, which Wadsworth played.
